requiredFindings.title: F00's UC window includes the schema commit that already landed
requiredFindings.failureScenario: F00's r5 split puts x3c.ledger-create.ddl.commit.after inside the UnknownCustody window, that point included (the r5 header and the F00 cell). In a36da7c write_schema, COMMIT must return Ok before crash_barrier!(_, "ddl.commit.after", step) under crash_scope x3c.ledger-create (project_ledger.rs lines 500-502 and 521-524). A kill at that point is after a successful schema commit. ReadSnapshot::open then sees the selected schema, read_pair and load_attempt return no rows, and join_ledger on (None, None) with no attempt is UnknownAttemptUnobserved (recovery.rs line 291). recover_from returns that standing (recover.rs lines 389-390). R1 is UAU, so the transcribed UC expectation, ledger-missing or ledger-unreadable, does not hold. X9-2 records that expectation in required-runs.v1.json before any run. Required: the UAU window starts at x3c.ledger-create.ddl.commit.after, that point included, and runs until x3c.attempt.commit.after. The UC window is from the draw through x3c.ledger-create.ddl.commit.before, reason ledger-missing or ledger-unreadable, whichever the kill left. R4 stays UAU in both windows. R3 still writes nothing. The rest of the F00 row stays. The undecided gap after x3c.ledger-create.wal and before ddl.commit stays undecided.

scope: Law X9 r5, an amendment. Three lead decisions for X9-2's required runs. RF-1: F00 includes ddl.commit.after in the UC window. No other accepted outcome changes. No product cargo.
